name: Relativism
overview: Scripture reveals the danger of relativism through the repeated observation that without divine authority, people choose what seems right to themselves, leading to moral chaos and death. Judges highlights a time when Israel had no king and every individual did what was right in their own eyes, illustrating the peril of subjective judgment. Proverbs warns that human reasoning can appear correct but ultimately leads to destruction, while Jeremiah exposes the deceitfulness of the human heart. True authority and wisdom come from God, as questioned by the religious leaders in Matthew when they challenge Jesus’ divine authority to teach and act.
